subject: reasoning
question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively? 

× and +, 3 and 9

I. 7 × 9 – 8 ÷ 2 + 3

II. 4 × 9 – 3 + 8 ÷ 2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers i.e :

__
 
• × and +
 
• Two numbers 3 and 9

So,

I. 7 + 3 – **8 ÷ 2**__ × 9

⇒ 7 + 3 - __**4 × 9**__

⇒ __**7 + 3**__ - 36

⇒ __**10 - 36**__

⇒ **-26**

II. 4 + 3 – 9 × __**8 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 4 + 3 - __**9 × 4**__

⇒ __**4 + 3**__ - 36

⇒ __**7 - 36**__

⇒ **-29**

Here, values of equation (I) and (II) are (-26) and (-29) respectively.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
